missing_claims.claim: Complete handle-bearing CD8a ADT oligo assigned to each of four Drop-seq FACS comparison aliquots
missing_claims.evidence: Source-positive scope: JATS lines 68 and 156 identify oligo-labelled CD8a/RPA-T8 and Drop-seq; Supplementary Table 2 lines 79–87 gives identifier GCCAAT; JATS lines 106–132 and author MOESM3 lines 403–434 print the 10x-v2-compatible v2_BC6 construct with that identifier. No inspected original expressly says that this same v2 handle, rather than another Drop-seq-compatible handle, was used in each FACS pool. Image-rich adjuncts and any linked raw-run records have not passed a complete two-reader check.

conclusion: Independent recheck followed original Drop-seq and CG00052 v2 capture documents and crosswalked CITE paper Methods to Supplementary Table 2 and the author protocol. Source-positive: human/mouse species mixing uses BC6/BC12 with branch-specific handles; the 10x v2 CBMC 13-antibody panel maps to v2_BC1–6 and v2_BC8–14. The extra v2_BC7 is printed by the author protocol but has no Table 2 panel assignment. Only the complete handle-bearing ADT oligo for each CD8a FACS validation aliquot remains blocked; no absence is accepted, and limited first-pass review of image-rich adjuncts still needs completion.
